provider.denyText: Direct provider access is not allowed here. Use the workspace wrappers (issue-*, pr-*, project-*, pipelines-*, release-list) with DEVENV_REPO set; if none covers what you need, report the gap to the user instead of working around it.

git.denyText: This git command changes repository state, and only read-only git is allowed here. Use the workspace tools instead: /devenv-commit (repo-commit) to commit, repo-stage to stage, git-wip for WIP snapshots; for anything else, show the user the exact command and ask them to run it.

parse.problemDenyText: This command could not be analyzed safely, so it is not allowed. Simplify it or split it into smaller commands, and avoid unbalanced quotes and deeply nested shells.
parse.dynamicDenyText: This command builds its program name from a variable or glob, so it cannot be checked. Write the program name out.
